description: A React component for browsing, searching, and managing channels in the Mattermost application, including modal interactions, filtering, and pagination.

classes.name: BrowseChannels
classes.description: A React component class for browsing and managing channels with filtering, searching, and modal interactions.

methods.name: loadComplete
methods.description: Sets the loading state to false after initial data fetch.

methods.name: handleNewChannel
methods.description: Opens the modal to create a new channel.

methods.name: handleExit
methods.description: Closes the modal for browsing channels.

methods.name: closeEditRHS
methods.description: Closes the right-hand side panel if it is in edit history state.

methods.name: onChange
methods.description: Resets search results and errors, optionally forcing update.

methods.name: nextPage
methods.description: Loads the next page of channels and updates member counts.

methods.name: handleJoin
methods.description: Handles user joining a channel, updates URL, and manages errors.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a delayed search for channels based on input term.

methods.name: setSearchResults
methods.description: Filters and sets search results based on current filters and membership.

methods.name: changeFilter
methods.description: Changes the channel filter and re-searches.

methods.name: isMemberOfChannel
methods.description: Checks if the current user is a member of a specific channel.

methods.name: handleShowJoinedChannelsPreference
methods.description: Updates user preference for hiding joined channels.

methods.name: getChannelsWithoutJoined
methods.description: Filters out channels the user has already joined.

methods.name: getActiveChannels
methods.description: Returns the list of channels based on current filters, search, and preferences.
